title: Hyperledger Iroha3
summary: Hyperledger Iroha 3 is the next-generation version of the Iroha framework that underpins SORA v3 (SORA Nexus). It introduces a redesigned data model, improved performance, and deterministic smart-contract execution via the Iroha Virtual Machine (IVM), where contracts are deployed as IVM bytecode (.to) and interact with the host ledger through Iroha Special Instructions (ISIs).
